title: Optimal Scheduling Algorithms for LLM Inference: Theory and Practice
authors: Agrim Bari; Parikshit Hegde; Gustavo de Veciana
venue_full: Proceedings of the ACM on Measurement and Analysis of Computing Systems (SIGMETRICS)
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, Queueing theory, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: LLM inference scheduling combines a compute-bound prefill phase and a memory-bandwidth-bound decode phase whose batch composition jointly determines throughput, TTFT, and TBT. Existing schedulers either prioritize prefill or decode, leaving the optimal tiling and dynamic resource-allocation strategy across heterogeneous SLOs uncharacterized in theory and unmet in practice.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 推理排程同時涉及 compute-bound 的 prefill phase 與 memory-bandwidth-bound 的 decode phase，其 batch 組成決定 throughput、TTFT 與 TBT；既有 scheduler 不是偏好 prefill 就是偏好 decode，理論上未刻畫最佳 tiling 與 dynamic resource allocation 策略，實務上也無法滿足異質 SLO。

key_innovation.en: A theoretical LLM-inference scheduling framework that models GeMM/GeMV tile-level batch processing time and proves a Resource-Aware Dynamic (RAD) scheduler is throughput-optimal under mild assumptions. The practical SLO-Aware LLM Inference (SLAI) scheduler instantiates these principles, using online TBT measurements to prioritize near-deadline decode-iterations and reordering prefill-phase requests by known prompt length to reduce median TTFT.
key_innovation.zh: 建立 LLM 推理排程的理論框架，將 GeMM/GeMV tile 層級的 batch 處理時間明確建模，並在溫和假設下證明 Resource-Aware Dynamic（RAD）scheduler 為 throughput-optimal；其實務版本 SLO-Aware LLM Inference（SLAI）scheduler 透過線上 TBT 量測優先處理接近 deadline 的 decode iteration，並以已知 prompt 長度重排 prefill 請求以降低 median TTFT。

key_improvements.en: Compared to Sarathi-Serve on Mistral-7B with the openchat_shareGPT4 trace: median TTFT reduced by 53%; maximum serving capacity increased by 26% while keeping median TTFT under 0.5 s and meeting tail TBT constraints.
key_improvements.zh: 於 Mistral-7B + openchat_shareGPT4 trace 下與 Sarathi-Serve 比較：median TTFT 降低 53%；在 median TTFT 低於 0.5 秒並滿足 tail TBT 限制的條件下，最大服務容量提升 26%。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (theoretical throughput-optimality proof; empirical claims expressed as TTFT/TBT and capacity rather than model MAPE)

scope_assumptions.en: Decoder-only Transformer with single-head attention generalized to GQA/MQA; GeMM/GeMV tile model assumes (a) sufficiently large matrices and (b) perfectly tiled, no-padding execution so the GPU hits peak FLOP/s; resource-planner does not turn nodes on/off (stationary arrivals); empirical evaluation on a single GPU and single model only; throughput-optimality proven under FCFS prefill ordering, with heterogeneous SLOs handled by the SLAI heuristic rather than re-proven optimal.
scope_assumptions.zh: decoder-only Transformer 並擴展支援 GQA/MQA；GeMM/GeMV tile 模型假設 (a) 矩陣足夠大且 (b) 完美對齊無 padding，使 GPU 達到 peak FLOP/s；resource planner 不做動態開關節點（穩態到達假設）；實驗僅於單 GPU 單模型上驗證；throughput-optimality 證明僅針對 FCFS prefill 排序，異質 SLO 由 SLAI 啟發式處理，未重新證明最佳性。
